Multiple red flags indicate this is a scam/phishing site: (1) The site is requesting payment ($4.99) for a 'free certificate' after a quiz, which is a classic bait-and-switch tactic. (2) It's requesting sensitive PII including full name, address, date of birth, SSN, and full credit card details (card number, expiry, CVV) - far more information than any legitimate certificate would require. (3) The domain 'braintest-iq.com' on a non-standard port (5305) appears suspicious and not like an official assessment platform. (4) Legitimate IQ tests (like those from accredited institutions) do not require SSN or full credit card information for certificates. (5) This follows the classic scam pattern: free quiz → results page → pressure to buy certificate → collect PII and payment. This is clearly a phishing/scam operation designed to harvest personal and financial information.
